# opnsense_firmware_settings (Resource)

Firmware repository settings (**System ▸ Firmware ▸ Settings**): mirror, flavour, release type and subscription. Plugins are managed with `opnsense_firmware_plugin`. This is a singleton: import it with the ID `firmware_settings` before managing it. Attributes left unset keep their current value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_firmware_settings.this
  id = "firmware_settings"
}

resource "opnsense_firmware_settings" "this" {
  mirror = "https://pkg.opnsense.org"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `flavour` (String) Package flavour, empty for the default.
- `mirror` (String) Package mirror URL, e.g. `https://pkg.opnsense.org`.
- `subscription` (String, Sensitive) Subscription key for business mirrors.
- `type` (String) Release type, empty for the community release.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `firmware_settings`.
